mount.message: Sire, a white peace for France vs Austria + Britain + Russia cannot be sealed as it stands: Settlement legitimacy. Author terms or hold until the field shifts.

per_court_acceptance.voice_line: Metternich holds Austria back from the table — Settlement legitimacy is the sticking point before they will sign.

holdout_actions.label: Ease Austria
holdout_actions.description: Soften terms toward Austria to bring them to the table.

holdout_actions.label: Drop Austria
holdout_actions.description: Drop Austria from the settlement; they remain at war.

dial_actions.label: Press Austria
dial_actions.description: Press Austria harder — applies to this court only.

demand_suggestions.label: Take Tyrol from Austria
demand_suggestions.reason_display: Tyrol sits beside what we already hold; Austria would keep it only on paper.

demand_suggestions.label: Demand 200 gold from Austria
demand_suggestions.reason_display: Austria's treasury can bear 200 gold — priced to wound the purse, not the pride.

demand_suggestions.label: Demand 100 gold a turn from Austria for 3 turns
demand_suggestions.reason_display: A tribute of 100 gold a turn for 3 turns — collected quietly, resented slowly, and well within Austria's means.

demand_suggestions.label: Vassalize Austria
demand_suggestions.reason_display: At 31% of our strength, Austria is better acquired than argued with.

demand_suggestions.label: Subjugate Austria
demand_suggestions.reason_display: At 31% of our strength, Austria cannot decline a master; subjugation merely sets it down in ink.

demand_suggestions.label: Force Austria into alliance
demand_suggestions.reason_display: An alliance signed under necessity still signs, Sire — Austria's weight moves to our side of the ledger.

demand_suggestions.label: Offer 300 gold to Austria
demand_suggestions.reason_display: A sweetener of 300 gold — Austria's resolve has a price, and it is conveniently paid in coin rather than provinces.

demand_suggestions.label: Offer Austria 100 gold a turn for 3 turns
demand_suggestions.reason_display: A pension of 100 gold a turn for 3 turns — Austria's peace bought on installment, gentler on the treasury than the war.

diplomatic_dialogue.multi_court_table_narration: Sire, this settlement of France vs Britain seats 3 courts at the table. Sire, Austria will not sign; the settlement of France vs Britain cannot be ratified until that court is eased toward terms or dropped to fight on.
